Specification: This module is a TLAPS proof layer for a spanning-tree protocol specification imported from the module spanning. It proves the safety property `Spec => []SntMsg`, where `SntMsg` states that a non-root process whose parent is not yet set has sent no messages. The proof strengthens the invariant with `SentMeansCanSend` and `PrntDomain`, then shows the combined invariant is inductive over `[Next]_vars`; comments also note a design issue in the imported spec's `TypeOK` regarding non-symmetric neighbor relations, so this proof avoids relying on that invariant.
IfThenElse: IF ii # root /\ prnt[ii] = NoPrnt /\ <<jj, ii>> \in msg THEN Update(ii, jj) ELSE \/ Send(ii) \/ Parent(ii) \/ UNCHANGED <<prnt, msg, rpt>>
AssumeProveBlocks:
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in Proc, NEW j \in Proc,
                            i # root, prnt'[i] = NoPrnt
                    PROVE  <<i, j>> \notin msg'

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in Proc, NEW j \in Proc,
                           <<i, j>> \in msg'
                    PROVE  i = root \/ prnt'[i] # NoPrnt

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in Proc, NEW j \in Proc,
                              i # root, prnt'[i] = NoPrnt
                      PROVE  <<i, j>> \notin msg'

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in Proc, NEW j \in Proc,
                              <<i, j>> \in msg'
                      PROVE  i = root \/ prnt'[i] # NoPrnt
